test_title: PYST 72: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 29 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. D sits third to the right of C. A sits second to the left of C. E sits second to the right of F. B sits to the immediate right of E. How many people sit between A and F when counted from the left of A?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

D sits third to the right of C.

A sits second to the left of C.

E sits second to the right of F.

B sits to the immediate right of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/741844f1e4bba5b558c2c47922d4f92d0f8b1d1bdcdd8371475e04f586450ba5.png] 

So, there are 4 people between A and F from the left of A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
